answer: No. In Virginia your dad can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2 electronically, with no notary; only Georgia still requires notarization. NW-POA-2 replaced the notarized NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and older NW-POA-1 forms were accepted only until June 30, 2026, so he should use NW-POA-2. When you bring the car, bring your own photo ID (a Virginia mobile ID on your phone is accepted) along with the car's documents.
